name: Superset With Postgresql
description: Modern data exploration and visualization platform (unofficial community docker image)
composeYaml:
services:
  superset:
    image: 'amancevice/superset:6.0.0'
    environment:
      - 'SECRET_KEY=${SUPERSETSECRETKEY}'
      - 'MAPBOX_API_KEY=${MAPBOX_API_KEY}'
      - 'POSTGRES_USER=${POSTGRES_USER}'
      - 'POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}'
      - 'POSTGRES_DB=${POSTGRES_DB:-superset-db}'
      - 'REDIS_PASSWORD=${REDIS_PASSWORD}'
    volumes:
      -
        type: bind
        source: ./superset/superset_config.py
        target: /etc/superset/superset_config.py
        content: "\"\"\"\nFor more configuration options, see:\n- https://superset.apache.org/docs/configuration/configuring-superset\n\"\"\"\n\nimport os\n\nSECRET_KEY = os.getenv(\"SECRET_KEY\")\nMAPBOX_API_KEY = os.getenv(\"MAPBOX_API_KEY\", \"\")\n\nCACHE_CONFIG = {\n  \"CACHE_TYPE\": \"RedisCache\",\n  \"CACHE_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT\": 300,\n  \"CACHE_KEY_PREFIX\": \"superset_\",\n  \"CACHE_REDIS_HOST\": \"redis\",\n  \"CACHE_REDIS_PORT\": 6379,\n  \"CACHE_REDIS_DB\": 1,\n  \"CACHE_REDIS_URL\": f\"redis://:{os.getenv('REDIS_PASSWORD')}@redis:6379/1\",\n}\n\nFILTER_STATE_CACHE_CONFIG = {**CACHE_CONFIG, \"CACHE_KEY_PREFIX\": \"superset_filter_\"}\nEXPLORE_FORM_DATA_CACHE_CONFIG = {**CACHE_CONFIG, \"CACHE_KEY_PREFIX\": \"superset_explore_form_\"}\n\nSQLALCHEMY_TRACK_MODIFICATIONS = True\nSQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URI = f\"postgresql+psycopg2://{os.getenv('POSTGRES_USER')}:{os.getenv('POSTGRES_PASSWORD')}@postgres:5432/{os.getenv('POSTGRES_DB')}\"\n\n# Uncomment if you want to load example data (using \"superset load_examples\") at the\n# same location as your metadata postgresql instance. Otherwise, the default sqlite\n# will be used, which will not persist in volume when restarting superset by default.\n#SQLALCHEMY_EXAMPLES_URI = SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URI"
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - curl
        - '-f'
        - 'http://127.0.0.1:8088/health'
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 20s
      retries: 10
  postgres:
    image: 'postgres:18'
    environment:
      - 'POSTGRES_USER=${POSTGRES_USER}'
      - 'POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}'
      - 'POSTGRES_DB=${POSTGRES_DB:-superset-db}'
    volumes:
      - 'superset_postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - 'pg_isready -U $${POSTGRES_USER} -d $${POSTGRES_DB}'
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 20s
      retries: 10
  redis:
    image: 'redis:8'
    volumes:
      - 'superset_redis_data:/data'
    command: 'redis-server --requirepass ${REDIS_PASSWORD}'
    healthcheck:
      test: 'redis-cli ping'
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 20s
      retries: 10
